name: Pits In The Park — 10th Anniversary
description: Join us for our landmark 10th annual Pits In The Park celebration! A full day of family-friendly activities, vendor booths, live demonstrations, adoptable dogs, raffles, and more. This is our biggest event of the year — don't miss it!

name: Spring Adoption Event
location: PetSmart — Lima Rd, Fort Wayne, IN
description: Meet our adoptable dogs in person at this special spring adoption event. Our fosters and volunteers will be on hand to answer questions and help you find your perfect match.

name: Community Walk for Pit Bulls
description: Lace up your walking shoes and join fellow pit bull advocates for a scenic walk along the Rivergreenway. All friendly, leashed dogs are welcome! Registration includes a t-shirt and goodie bag.
